entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord himself in his inmost Divine; the Divine Esse from which all love and wisdom proceeds; the unmeasured source of all influx.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord in his inmost Divine / the Father of Greatness as the Divine Esse
entries.opposite_sense: King of Darkness (the ruling self-love personified)
entries.definition: Called 'Father' because origin of all; called 'Greatness' because measureless. He is hidden in the inmost; from his five members of light all emanations come forth; he stands as the First-Standing-Fast against whom no opposition reaches.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Divine Wisdom in her receptive matrix from which spiritual life is brought forth; the bringing-forth of Divine Truth from Divine Good; the maternal pole of divine generation.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Wisdom in her bringing-forth / the matrix of divine life
entries.opposite_sense: Hyle / Enthumesis of Death (the corrupt matrix that generates falsities)
entries.definition: She is the first emanation from the Father; she summons forth the First Man; she gives him the right hand of peace and the embrace of love; she bears upward all the powers; she is the maternal pole opposed to Hyle.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth sent into the realm of self-love to overcome it; the Divine Human in his descent into the natural; the form of love and wisdom that battles the proprium.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Truth descending into the natural / the Divine Human in his redemptive mission
entries.opposite_sense: King of Darkness (the proprium against whom he descends)
entries.definition: He goes down to the Deep clothed in five elements; he is mingled with darkness; he is brought up by the Living Spirit; his five sons are the Living Soul. The seal of the entire cosmos is sealed in him; the cosmos is built in his likeness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The operative power of Divine Truth that builds spiritual structure in the natural; the influx that establishes order in receptive states; the Divine Spirit operative in regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the operative Divine power that builds order / the Spirit in his structuring work
entries.definition: He brings up the First Man from the contest; he establishes the worlds and the firmaments through three garments (wind, fire, water); he is the Great Builder in operative aspect; he wears the elements as the means by which spiritual influx takes form in nature.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The call of Divine Truth that awakens trapped light; the Lord's specific operation through revealed image to extract good from the mingled state.
entries.use_in_reading: the awakening call of Divine Truth / the Lord in his revealing image
entries.definition: He dwells in the ship of light/day; through his image revealed before the archons the light is selected forth; he sends the Mind of Light to mankind; he is the King of the Zone, Lord of all counsels.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth shining forth as Redeemer; the Lord glorifying his Human, manifest in the world to release captive light; active emission of saving truth.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Truth in its shining-forth as Redeemer / Jesus as the active radiance of saving truth
entries.definition: His title preserves an active emission verb (ⲡⲣⲓⲉ = 'shine forth'). He is sent to rescue the soul; he calls three powers (Mind of Light, the Judge, the Pillar). He is 'the Father of all the apostles.' He descended through ten chariots into the cosmos. Title NOT to be rendered as 'Splendor' which is static.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Purity of reception; truth uncorrupted; Divine Wisdom in her uncorrupted form before the mingling; the soul of the elect in her pure receptive state — what the New Man wears as robe.
entries.use_in_reading: purity of reception / Divine Wisdom in her uncorrupted form / the chosen soul as virgin-bride
entries.opposite_sense: Hyle (corrupt receptivity / the Enthumesis of Death)
entries.definition: She steals the heart of the aeons by her image; she is the perfection of pride-of-heart of greatness; she takes the heart of Adam; she manifests to the chosen at separation from the body, drawing him from the demons by her kiss; she is the robe of the New Man.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The path of ascent from natural to celestial; accumulated truth rising as column; the way by which all redeemed light returns to its source; the axis of regenerative ascent.
entries.use_in_reading: the column of accumulated truth that rises homeward / the path of ascent
entries.definition: He bears upward all the burdens of the cosmos; he is the perfect Man; he is the Great Mind in cosmic structure; through him souls go up. He is the body of the Pillar of Glory's pillar (head laid upon it). He is the Great Pillar of Praise, Great Omophoros bearing all sub-omophoroi.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth in its ruling judicial power over the firmaments; the rational discriminating presence of the Lord governing the natural heavens.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Truth ruling in judicial power / the Lord governing the heavens of the natural
entries.definition: He sits enthroned in the seventh firmament; he is the fifth great judge giving daily judgment over all generations; he turns the wheels; he is correlated with Thought in the body's microcosm; the seventh wheel-wheel turns from him.

natural_variants: the Great Builder of the Spirit
entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Wisdom in its shaping aspect; the Lord's operative wisdom that builds the new aeon and orders the cosmos.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Wisdom in its shaping power / the Lord ordering the structure of heaven
entries.definition: He builds the new aeon; he establishes the prison-house for the Enemy; he is the fifth throne; sometimes manifesting as a rich man, an architect who builds for the king; one of the five sons of the Living Spirit.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Illumined rational understanding; the awakening of spiritual intelligence in the regenerate human; the Lord's truth made present to the inner mind; the rational of the spiritual mind.
entries.use_in_reading: illumined rational understanding / the awakened spiritual mind
entries.opposite_sense: the Old Man / the proprium-mind in its fallen reasoning
entries.definition: He is the awakener of sleepers; he comes to the body and binds Sin's members one by one; he places love in the mind, faith in the thought, etc., forming the New Man within. He is the eleventh judge; he overcomes the archons of the senses by wisdom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Love in its emanating aspect; the dearness of the Lord proceeding from the Father; the principle by which all love returns home.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Love in its emanation
entries.definition: He is the Father's second emanation; honored, loved; the great Beloved who is glorious; he stands at the fourth throne; from him the great Builder is in turn brought forth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The ruling love of self personified; the chief of the falsities-from-evil; the proprium in its dominating principle; the head of all hells.
entries.use_in_reading: the ruling love of self / self-love personified as cosmic principle
entries.definition: He has five forms in his body — lion-head, eagle-shoulders/hands, demon-feet, fish-belly, dragon-tail — these are the modes of self-love manifest in cosmic order. Gold is his body. He is the principal antagonist who plotted against the Living Soul. His sense-perception sees only what is before his face.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Divine subduer of matter; the firstfruit of light's victory imprinted upon receptive form; the warrior-image of regenerative truth that pins down concupiscence.
entries.use_in_reading: the divine subduer of matter / the warrior-image of regeneration
entries.definition: He is sent down to subdue the desire of death after she comes up to destroy the works of life; he sets his foot upon her until the end of the cosmos; he is the third great realm-power. In some passages identified with the Living Power overcoming flesh.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The hellish demiurge; the falsity-from-self-love that molds the unregenerate human; the proprium in its fashioning role.
entries.use_in_reading: the demiurge of self-love / the falsity that molds the unregenerate human
entries.definition: Wellspring of demons; with his consort he plots and molds Adam and Eve, sealing upon them the icon of the Exalted One stolen by Sin from the Ambassador's revealed image. The hostile counterpart of the Great Builder.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural man as molded; the proprium being formed; the first state of humanity in which divine truth is sealed but in mingled corruption; the human race in its initial molded condition.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural man as molded / the proprium in its first formation
entries.opposite_sense: the New Man / the regenerate self
entries.definition: Molded by the archons after the icon of the Exalted One revealed by the Ambassador; Adam ate from the tree and his eyes saw forth — the natural man comes to outward perception. The seal of the entire cosmos is sealed in Adam (he is microcosm).

entries.spiritual_meaning: Concupiscence as cosmic principle; the active falsity-of-self-love that generates corrupt forms from itself; the corrupt feminine pole opposed to Mother of Life.
entries.use_in_reading: concupiscence as generating principle / the desire of death
entries.opposite_sense: Mother of Life (the true generative principle)
entries.definition: Mother of the giants; she molded herself out of the elements alone; she is the painter (zōgraphos) and contriver; the wellspring of all evils. She is the maternal pole of corruption. She is the door for the ones of darkness, who set herself for war against the aeons of divinity.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The divine restraining power that holds back evil; the patience of Divine Wisdom that prevents falsity from breaking forth more than is permitted.
entries.use_in_reading: the divine restraining power / the holder against evil's outbreak
entries.definition: He stands fast holding together the prison of the bound ones; he restrains the powers from ascending out of place; Sin opposes him in his watch and seeks to gush up against him.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The divine bearing-up that supports all natural creation; the patience of Divine Wisdom carrying the burden of the natural cosmos; the lowest column of love-bearing-truth in ultimates.
entries.use_in_reading: the divine bearing-up that supports the natural / the bearer of the cosmos
entries.definition: He stands fast with foot on the lowest land holding up the lands and the entire creation. The four mountains stand at his feet. Jesus comes down to comfort his lower shoulders that have grown weary. He is the head of all heaven-bearers.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proprium / the unregenerate self; the natural man before regeneration; the body bound to Sin; what mounts upon the soul like a rider before the Lord overcomes it.
entries.use_in_reading: the unregenerate self / the proprium / the Old Man
entries.definition: Reigns among the doctrines (in cosmic correspondence); he is the seventh dwelling-place under the law of death; he is what the Mind of Light subdues; he is rooted in the body. Mounted upon the soul like a rider — the old loves dominating natural life.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The regenerate self; the spiritual mind formed by the Lord in the soul; the man of righteousness clothed with the Virgin of Light; the receptacle of love, faith, perfection, patience, and wisdom.
entries.use_in_reading: the regenerate self / the New Man as the spiritual mind
entries.definition: Established when the Mind of Light comes; fashioned in twelve members which are love (in mind), faith (in thought), teaching, patience (in counsel), wisdom (in reflection), and others; wears the Virgin of Light as his robe; reigns within the body.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fallen heavenly intelligences; rational truths that descended through their own desire and were imprisoned; corrupt members of the heavenly host bound in the abyss.
entries.use_in_reading: the fallen Watchers / rational truths that descended and were imprisoned
entries.opposite_sense: the holy Watchers (the Five Watchers, the Unsleeping Ones, t.38)
entries.definition: They came down from above to the earth; opened the irons; revealed mysteries of heaven; were bound by the four angels in the prison of the darkened ones. Their twelve cities were ordered; their sons would have lived a thousand years.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The personified principle of evil-from-self-love active in the cosmos and in the body; falsity that struggles against the Light; the principle that pursues and seeks to corrupt every receptive image.
entries.use_in_reading: Sin (the personified principle of evil-from-self-love) — capitalize when personified
entries.definition: Sin gushes up against the icon of the Ambassador; she is mingled with the soul; she is bound in the bones, sinews, veins, flesh, skin (each faculty); she is what the New Man strips off. Five works of Sin: greed, lust, gain, war, deception.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The cosmic principle of falsity-as-deception; the wandering principle that misleads souls; the painter of false images that obscure the true icon.
entries.use_in_reading: Error (cosmic falsity / deception) — capitalize when personified as cosmic entity
entries.definition: Error is sent forth into the worlds; she scatters teachings; the Ambassador must drive her out; the Error itself is bound in the dragon-form. She is the law of the cosmos that lays the souls in suffering. Drives the wheel of stars by her rotation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The ruling principle of spiritual non-being; the king-pole of darkness in its destructive aspect; the cessation of conjunction with the Divine.
entries.use_in_reading: Death (the cosmic principle of spiritual non-being) — capitalize when personified
entries.definition: Death stood up to plant himself eternally. There are two deaths: first death = the mingled state during the cosmos; second death = the final separation of the unredeemed in the bolos. King with Sin in t.5.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The cosmic principle of opposition to the Divine; the first death which gushed forth from the Land of Darkness; the negative pole that the First Man comes to seize.
entries.use_in_reading: Enmity (the principle of opposition to the Lord)
entries.definition: Enmity is the first death gushing forth from the Land of Darkness, sinning against another foreign power. Hatred is opposed to the Agape, which is the bond of the Greatness. The First Man's mission is to seize the Enmity.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth dispersed in the natural creation; the Lord's truth-power held captive in matter; what is to be redeemed; the suffering Christ-figure in nature.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Truth dispersed in the natural / the soul to be redeemed
entries.definition: She is crucified in every body and tree; she suffers the dispersal; she is purified daily through the food of the elect; she is gathered upward by the Calling and the Hearing into the new aeon. The five sons of First Man who are Living Soul are mingled in the elements.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The consummating perfect-image at the end of the cosmos; the totality of the redeemed soul gathered into final form; the final extraction of all light.
entries.use_in_reading: the final consummating image of redeemed light / the gathering-statue at the end
entries.opposite_sense: the bolos (the final clod of unredeemed)
entries.definition: At the end the Last Andrias arises, gathering all remaining light. He is built from the residues. He is the final form of the Living Soul gathered up before the cosmos dissolves. After him the unredeemed go to the bolos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord in his sending of revealed truth into the world; the manifesting Word; the messenger who brings the Mind of Light to humans.
entries.use_in_reading: the Apostle / Christ as the Lord's sent revealed truth
entries.opposite_sense: the false teachers / the Error of the cosmos
entries.definition: The first power that Jesus called is the apostle. The blessed Christ comes to cut down the Error of the cosmos. The apostle is the messenger of the Mind of Light. The apostles bear three angels with the form of light when sending.

entries.english_term: Five Sons of the First Man
entries.spiritual_meaning: The five attributes of Divine Truth as it descends; the Living Soul in five-fold completeness corresponding to the five faculties; the elements as living-soul.
entries.use_in_reading: the five attributes of Divine Truth descending / the five-fold Living Soul
entries.opposite_sense: the five forms of the King of Darkness's body
entries.definition: Living air, living wind, living light, living water, living fire — the elements as the soul's five-fold form. They are the soul mingled with darkness. They scattered in the worlds and must be gathered upward.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Wisdom; Divine Truth in its illuminating quality; the substance of the Father's land; what enables spiritual sight.
entries.use_in_reading: wisdom / Divine Truth shining
entries.definition: Light enables the eye to distinguish forms — it corresponds to truth that distinguishes good from evil. Light is the Father's substance; it bears up under all the gods, angels, and dwelling-places. Light is mingled with darkness from the beginning of the conflict.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsity from evil; the absence of spiritual light; the ground from which self-love operates; the principle of opposition to truth.
entries.use_in_reading: falsity from evil / the absence of spiritual light
entries.definition: The substance from which the King of Darkness rules; the principle of opposition to truth; bound and gathered into the final clod at the end. It came against the light from the beginning. The Land of Darkness is the totality of self-love's state.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Love / will. Living Fire = divine love. Common burning fire = lust and corrupt love-of-self.
entries.use_in_reading: love / the will (positive); lust / the burning of self-love (negative); Living Fire = divine love
entries.opposite_sense: the fire of darkness / corrupt lust opposes the Living Fire / divine love
entries.definition: Fire gives light its existence — it corresponds to love which gives wisdom its life. Living Fire is the divine love, what burns in those who are conjoined to the Lord. The fire of the archons is destructive lust. Fire as element does five works: releases, separates, gives taste, forms vessels, illuminates.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Truth in the natural degree; doctrine that sustains spiritual life. Living Water = divine truth flowing. The salt sea = mingled state of truth and falsity.
entries.use_in_reading: truth in the natural degree (positive) / natural truth in mingled state (the salt sea)
entries.opposite_sense: the waters of error / dead water of the bitter springs
entries.definition: Water sustains natural life — it corresponds to natural truth that sustains spiritual life. Living water flows from above. The salt sea (mingled water) is the natural mind in its mixed condition. The Bitter Sea is the result of the purification of the three places of deceit.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Thought / perception; the medium of spiritual communication; the breath of life; the moving thought between minds.
entries.use_in_reading: thought / perception / the breath of spiritual life
entries.opposite_sense: the corrupt wind of error / disordered perception
entries.definition: Wind/air is the medium by which sound and breath travel — it corresponds to thought and perception. Living Air receives the soul's breath. The Father's first emanation is the Great Spirit (= air). The fourth wheel turns by wind's motion.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsity arising from evil that obscures spiritual light; confused thought from mingled affection; the false-mind world of darkness.
entries.use_in_reading: falsity arising from evil / confused thought obscuring truth
entries.definition: Smoke obscures light — it corresponds to falsity that obscures truth. The first world of darkness is smoke (the corrupt mind-world); its King's body is gold (fallen good of self-love). Smoke fills the gehenna of the bitter teaching.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind as ground; the lowest plane of existence where seeds (interior truths) grow into perceptions (trees) and works (fruits).
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind / the ground of natural life
entries.opposite_sense: Land of Light vs. Land of Darkness as opposite states of natural mind
entries.definition: Land of Light = the natural mind purified, conjoined with Divine Truth; Land of Darkness = the natural mind as falsity-ground; the new land = the regenerated natural mind. The body is built upon the earth in its likeness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The hells; the depth of falsity-from-evil; the lowest interior of self-love; the place of the abortions and demons.
entries.use_in_reading: the hells / the depth of falsity
entries.opposite_sense: the Height (the heavens) / the upper place
entries.definition: From the Deep the abortions and demons arise; the King of Darkness comes from the Deep; into the Deep the Sin will be cast at the end. Sometimes the place where the First Man descends to battle.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind in its receptive depth; the affections of the natural with their salt of mingling; the place where pearls (refined truths) are formed by heavenly drops falling into receptive natural shells.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural in its receptive depth / the salty mingled-state of natural affections
entries.definition: The great sea is salty (mingled); the prow of the sea has the constellations sealed in it; pearls are formed in oysters in the sea — natural truths refined into precious truths through union with the heavenly drop.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The quality of falsity from evil; what the soul receives when it eats from the corrupt tree; the taste of disordered love.
entries.use_in_reading: the quality of falsity-from-evil / the taste of corrupt affection
entries.definition: The bitter tree, the bitter fruits, the bitter land — all describe the false state. Hyle's begettings are bitter. Bronze (body of King of Fire) tastes bitter. The fourth-fifth members of evil are the bitterness of the body.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The quality of divine good; the taste of divine love and truth; the savor of the regenerate state.
entries.use_in_reading: the quality of divine good / the taste of divine love
entries.definition: The land of sweetness; the sweet fragrance of the Father; living ambrosia in the Land of Light. The pure tree's fruits are sweet. The water of the receptive natural can become sweet when it receives the heavenly drop.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of conjoined truth and falsity in the natural mind; the present condition of the soul before regeneration; light bound in darkness; the substance to be sorted.
entries.use_in_reading: the mingled state of truth and falsity / light bound in darkness
entries.definition: Light is mingled with darkness from the beginning of the conflict; this mingling is the substance to be purified. The Living Soul is mingled. All things in the cosmos are in a state of mixture awaiting the work of separation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Five degrees of divine good stored in interior states; the inner repositories of perceptive memory; the Lord's stored truths kept against the time of need.
entries.use_in_reading: the inner repositories of received truths / the Lord's stored degrees of good
entries.definition: Five storehouses are kept by the First Man; the Father's hidden storehouses; the storehouses of the eye, ear, mouth, hand, heart — each sense has its own. The senses store and retrieve. The storehouses of Hyle hold her corrupt forms.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The fixed boundary between states; the established order of heavenly states held against falsity; the discrete degrees as ordered.
entries.use_in_reading: the fixed boundary between states / the established discrete degrees
entries.definition: There are seven (and ten) firmaments above; they hold the order of the heavens; the seventh firmament holds the throne of the King of Honor. The firmaments correspond to the body's neck-to-heart region in the cosmic-body correspondence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Cyclic process of purification; recurrent process in ultimates; the turning of states by which good is gathered out of evil; the rotation of natural states under spiritual influence.
entries.use_in_reading: cyclic process of purification / the turning of natural states
entries.definition: The wheel of the stars turns; the King of Honor sits at its center; each thing of darkness is bound to it that the light may be drawn out. Three wheels are mentioned (wind, water, fire) in the Living Spirit's establishment.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The doctrinal vessel that carries truth across the natural; the body as receptacle of divine truth; the means of ascent; the sun and moon as the two ships of light.
entries.use_in_reading: the doctrinal vessel carrying truth / the body or luminary as ascent-vessel
entries.definition: Ship of light; ship of the day (sun); ship of the night (moon). Souls are carried in vessels of light back to the Father. Jesus the Son rides on chariots/vessels (ten in number). The First Ambassador dwells in the ship of light.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The point of entry between states; the doctrinal opening through which influx flows; the opening of receptivity in the soul; the seven gates of the body's senses.
entries.use_in_reading: the point of entry between states / the doorway of receptivity
entries.opposite_sense: the Gate of Slaughter / Gate of Honor (false vs. true gate)
entries.definition: Gates of slaughter (negative); Gate of Honor (positive); the gates of the firmaments open at sunrise and shut at sunset; the gates of the body's senses (seven from neck up).

entries.spiritual_meaning: Confirmed truth or correspondence imprinted in form; the mark of conjunction; the divine character imprinted in the soul; the stamp by which a state is fixed.
entries.use_in_reading: the imprint of confirmed correspondence / the seal of conjunction
entries.opposite_sense: the false seal (the stolen imprint of the icon by Sin)
entries.definition: The seal of the cosmos is in Adam (he is microcosm); the seal of light upon the soul; seals are placed in mediating elements; they are imprinted in the heart. Twelve seals exist in the Wheel — markers of the discrete degrees.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsities and evils that bind the spirit; the captive state of the Living Soul; the imprisonment of light by darkness; the binding of the proprium.
entries.use_in_reading: the bonds of falsity that hold the spirit / the chains of self-love
entries.definition: Souls are released from all bonds and chains by Jesus; the King of Darkness binds with chains; the final bond holds the Enemy forever. Sin binds the mind in the bone, thought in the sinew, etc.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A state of divine love and wisdom; a heavenly community; an order of being from the Father; a discrete level of the heavens.
entries.use_in_reading: a state of divine love and wisdom / a heavenly community
entries.opposite_sense: the cosmos (the world of mingled state) vs. the aeon (the world of conjoined state)
entries.definition: Aeons of Light surround the Father; the New Aeon is the heaven of regeneration where redeemed souls dwell forever; twelve great Aeons constitute the fullness of greatness. Each chosen one rests in his own aeon-tabernacle.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A complete state of being; a world of life. Multiple worlds = multiple discrete states. The cosmos as the present mingled-state arena where the Living Soul is being purified.
entries.use_in_reading: the cosmos / a complete state of being / the present world of mingled truth and falsity
entries.opposite_sense: the aeon (state of pure conjunction) vs. the cosmos (mingled state)
entries.definition: Five worlds of darkness = five modes of self-love; five worlds of light = five degrees of divine reception; the cosmos is built after the body of man — heaven and earth correspond to head and feet of the cosmic-man. The whole cosmos is also called the body of man writ large.

entries.spiritual_meaning: External truths clothing the spiritual meaning; the form in which truth or love is borne in ultimates; the soul's outer state; the body in metensomatosis.
entries.use_in_reading: external truths that clothe spiritual meaning / the soul's outer form
entries.opposite_sense: the foul garment (the body of corruption) vs. the garment of light
entries.definition: The First Man wears five garments to the war (the elements). The Living Spirit's three garments are wind, fire, water. The Virgin of Light is the robe of the New Man. Garments are the bodies in which souls undergo metensomatosis.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Representational correspondence; the form by which one state expresses another; the image of God in form; the relational quality of being-after.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'likeness' (or 'icon' for ⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ); never 'form,' 'image,' 'shape,' 'kind' for ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ
entries.opposite_sense: the false likeness (Hyle's image-painting) vs. the true icon (the Ambassador's revealed image)
entries.definition: The icon of the Ambassador is what the archons see and try to imitate. Adam is molded after the icon of the Exalted One. The first cosmos is in the likeness of the Living Spirit. Mandatory translation: ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ = 'likeness.' Distinguish from ⲙⲟⲣⲫⲏ = 'form.'

entries.spiritual_meaning: The ruling principle of glory; the conjoining truth that crowns the regenerate state; the seal of victory of the Lord upon his chosen.
entries.use_in_reading: the crown of glory / the ruling principle of conjunction
entries.definition: The wreath of light grasps in five elements. The third angel of light bears the diadem and the wreath. The chosen receive the crown of glory in life forever. The first woman is a wreath upon the whole earth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Dominion / state of rule; the seat from which divine truth governs; the established place of authority in heaven.
entries.use_in_reading: the throne of dominion / the seat of governing truth
entries.definition: Eight or nine great thrones are described — the Father's, the Mother's, the First Man's, the Beloved's, the Builder's, the Living Spirit's, the Ambassador's, Jesus's, and the gathering throne. Each is a state of rule by a particular divine attribute.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Confirmed state held against opposing influence; the binding-houses of the captured darkness; the dwelling-places of confined falsity.
entries.use_in_reading: the confirmed binding-state / the stronghold of confined falsity
entries.definition: Three or four strongholds surround the cosmos; they hold the captured archons. Stronghold of darkness = state of confined falsity. Stronghold of fire = state of confined corrupt love. Stronghold of water = state of confined corrupt natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The dwelling-place of divine in human; the established seat of divine truth in the spiritual mind; the soul's heavenly mansion in its aeon.
entries.use_in_reading: the dwelling-place of divine truth / the soul's heavenly mansion
entries.definition: The Judge has a tabernacle established in the air. The Mother's tabernacle. Each aeon has its own tabernacle. The First Man's tabernacle is established in the Second Chariot.

entries.spiritual_meaning: An ordered host of truths or affections set against opposing host; the disposition of heavenly forces in cosmic war.
entries.use_in_reading: the ordered host of truths / the cosmic encampment of divine forces
entries.opposite_sense: the encampment of darkness / the legions of the King of Darkness
entries.definition: The encampment of the Egregoroi; encampments of the Great Mind; the encampment of those who came down. Each major divine figure has an encampment. The body itself is likened to an encampment with gates.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth crucified in the natural; the Living Soul's suffering in matter; the redemptive cross of the Lord's tribulation in the world; the soul's dispersal as the basis of redemption.
entries.use_in_reading: Divine Truth crucified in the natural / the soul dispersed as the Lord's redemptive cross
entries.definition: The Living Soul is crucified in the cross of light upon every tree and flesh; she is poured out in the world; she is the suffering Christ-figure in nature. The chosen scatter upon the cross of light at sunrise.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Precious truth refined from natural conjunction; the soul as gem produced through union of heavenly drop and receptive natural.
entries.use_in_reading: the precious refined truth / the soul as gem of heavenly-natural union
entries.definition: A drop of rain (Living Spirit) falling into the oyster (the receptive natural) makes a pearl. The process shows the refining of truth: the natural concrete softness must receive the heavenly drop. Divers (chalkmse) bring pearls up to kings.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The cosmic circuit of natural states; the wheeling of the zodiac in which the binding of natural-mind movements happens; the disc of natural rotation containing all natural truths.
entries.use_in_reading: the cosmic circuit of natural states / the zodiac as binding-wheel
entries.definition: The sphere holds the zodiac signs and the planets; it is bound up by the wheel; it sows souls into bodies through its rotation; it binds the archons. The mystery of natural cyclic motion.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The final compacted state of evil sealed at the consummation; the eternal binding of self-love; the residue of unredeemed darkness fixed forever.
entries.use_in_reading: the final compacted state of evil / the bolos (the eternal binding of unredeemed darkness)
entries.definition: At the end the Sin and Hyle are sealed in the bolos forever. The remaining unredeemed light is built into the Last Andrias upon the bolos. The bolos is the final tomb.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of spiritual death; the buried captivity of falsity; the grave of unredeemed self-love at the consummation.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of spiritual death / the tomb of unredeemed darkness
entries.definition: The Darkness is taken into the tomb at the end. The female of evil is brought into the tomb in the third plague.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of the heavens; the Lord's heaven where divine love and wisdom reign in fullness; the celestial degree.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of the heavens / the Father's celestial land
entries.definition: The Father's land where the substance of Light dwells; all gods, angels, dwelling-places established to fullness; living ambrosia, light forever, no death and no darkness in it.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of the hells; the realm of self-love and falsity-from-evil; the corrupt natural mind; the home of the King of Darkness.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of the hells / the realm of self-love
entries.definition: From it the five worlds of darkness gushed forth; the King of Darkness rules there; bitter, dark, with five elements gushing. The corrupt natural mind in its principial state.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Five modes of self-love's expression; the five-fold complete structure of the proprium; the discrete degrees of self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: the five modes of self-love / the discrete degrees of the proprium
entries.opposite_sense: Five Storehouses of the First Man (the five degrees of divine reception)
entries.definition: Smoke (mind/king of mind), Fire (king lion-faced), Wind (eagle-faced), Water (fish-faced), Darkness (dragon-faced). Each world has its king, its body, its taste — the proprium fully articulated through the five faculties' corruptions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: An ordered place of vigilance in the cosmic-body; the appointed guard-state of each divine watcher; the disposition of senses as cosmic guardians.
entries.use_in_reading: the watch-station / the appointed guard-state of vigilance
entries.definition: Five watches correspond to the Five Sons of the Living Spirit; each oversees a part of the cosmic-body; each has its watch where particular events of the salvation history happen.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Boundary protecting state; the great fire-wall surrounding the cosmos; the protecting truth around the heavenly mansion.
entries.use_in_reading: the protecting boundary / the wall around the state
entries.definition: The four walls surround the strongholds. The Wall of the Great Fire surrounds the worlds. The outer wall (sabt) is the body of the cosmic-man.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The form of love and wisdom in ultimates; the natural in which the soul is contained; the seat of correspondence with cosmic structure; the vehicle of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the body / the natural form / the body as ultimate of love-and-wisdom
entries.opposite_sense: the body of darkness (the King of Darkness's five-formed body) vs. the body of the cosmic-man
entries.definition: The body of the King of Darkness has five forms (lion, eagle, demon, fish, dragon). The body of man is the cosmos in miniature. The body is built like the cosmos. Body of flesh = the proprium's outer form. Body of light = the regenerate state.

entries.spiritual_meaning: State of internal expressing in external; what is presented outward of the inner state; the visible aspect of the divine.
entries.use_in_reading: the face / the state expressed outward
entries.definition: The Faces of the Light (four or five); the face of the Father, the face of the Sun, the face of the Moon. Five Faces of Light vs. four Faces of Darkness. The face = the manifesting aspect of inner state.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The measure of regenerate quality; how full a soul has grown in spiritual receptivity; the magnitude of celestial form.
entries.use_in_reading: the spiritual stature / the measure of regenerate growth
entries.definition: The stature of light = the cosmos. The First Man's stature is his four sons mounted on his body. Adam's stature was great in earlier ages because more light was in the world.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The inmost / the principal / the will or its inmost rational; the place of governance in the spiritual organism.
entries.use_in_reading: the head / the inmost ruling principle / the governing place
entries.opposite_sense: the lion-head of the King of Darkness (false dominion)
entries.definition: The head is where the root of all members hangs (per t.31); the head of the King of Darkness is a lion-face. Mind is the head over all faculties. Cutting off the head = death of the whole. The Father's head is laid upon the body of the Pillar of Glory.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The intellect / the understanding; the receptive faculty of light/truth; the organ of spiritual seeing.
entries.use_in_reading: the eye / the understanding / the intellectual faculty
entries.opposite_sense: the eye blinded (the natural understanding without illumination)
entries.definition: The eyes see, store images in their treasuries, give back when asked. The two eyes correspond to the two ships of light (sun and moon) in the cosmos. Adam's eyes opened = the natural understanding awakening. Each eye has seven hidden things.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Confession / expression of truth; the doorway through which the soul speaks and receives nourishment; the site of taste-receiving.
entries.use_in_reading: the mouth / the doorway of expression and reception
entries.definition: The mouth is the place of receiving-taste; speech proceeds through it; Sin opens the mouths of those who serve it. With tongue, teeth, lips it forms the word — mystery of the begetting of the word.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Obedience / hearing; the receptive faculty of doctrine; the organ of receiving the Calling.
entries.use_in_reading: the ear / receptive hearing / obedience to truth
entries.definition: The two ears correspond to the breasts in cosmic correspondence (per t.71). They store hearings in their treasuries for ten hundred days. They are the receptacles of speech-truth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Power / capacity to act; the means by which truth or falsity executes its purpose; the right hand specifically signifies divine power for blessing or grasping.
entries.use_in_reading: the hand / power to act / right hand = divine power for blessing
entries.opposite_sense: the hand of the enemy (claws, grasp of self-love)
entries.definition: The right hand of the Mother of Life; the hand of peace; the laying-on-of-hands (chirotonia) of the Mother on the First Man. The hand acts as principal agent of will. Five mysteries are five gestures of hand-related power.

entries.spiritual_meaning: External / ultimate / the lowest plane of natural action; what is set down upon the lowest things.
entries.use_in_reading: the foot / the external / the ultimate plane of action
entries.definition: Adamas's foot is set upon Hyle until the end. The Omophoros's feet are above the four mountains. Setting foot is establishing dominion in ultimates. The body's feet correspond to the underground / Omophoros.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Particular faculty or principle as part of the whole; particular truth-or-affection in the spiritual organism; a discrete operative element.
entries.use_in_reading: a member / a particular faculty in the spiritual organism
entries.definition: The five members of the Father (his five faculties); the twelve members of the New Man; the members of the soul are bound in members of the body. Members of darkness vs. members of light.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The will / love itself; the inmost seat of affection; the sovereign place where the enthumesis abides.
entries.use_in_reading: the heart / the will / the love itself
entries.definition: The heart is where the enthumesis (counsel) abides as king; all the other senses give their treasures to the heart's enthumesis. The Father's purpose-of-heart governs all. The Virgin takes the heart of Adam.

entries.spiritual_meaning: External love (rare positive) / the proprium / natural concupiscence (typical negative); the body of fallen substance.
entries.use_in_reading: the flesh / the natural concupiscence / the proprium's outer form
entries.opposite_sense: the spirit / the regenerate body of light
entries.definition: The flesh is the body of fallen substance; the five worlds of flesh = the proprium fully articulated; flesh is what the demons gather to gain. The Lord must come in the flesh of the apostle to redeem. The desire of the flesh = concupiscence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Structural good; the framework of inmost truths that supports; the fixed foundation of inner principles.
entries.use_in_reading: the bone / structural good / the framework of supporting truths
entries.definition: The mind is bound in the bone (in the Sin-bound state). Bones are the firm structure of the body; corresponds to the framework of inmost truths in the natural. Reflection bound in skin, mind in bone — Sin bound the faculties in body-correspondences.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Power of truth communicated; the conducting strength of doctrine; structure-in-motion.
entries.use_in_reading: the sinew / the power of communicated truth
entries.definition: Thought is bound in the sinew (in Sin-bound state). The sinew is the conducting strength.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Communicating truth; the conducting channels of life; that by which the divine truth flows in the natural.
entries.use_in_reading: the vein / the communicating channels of truth
entries.definition: Teaching is bound in the vein (in Sin-bound state). The veins are channels of life.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Outermost truth / external; what clothes the body in ultimates; what the elements form upon the body.
entries.use_in_reading: the skin / the outermost ultimate / what clothes in ultimates
entries.definition: Reflection is bound in the skin (in Sin-bound state). The skin is the seventh layer in the molding of the New Man's body-likeness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Perception or knowledge that grows and bears; the receptive principle that yields fruit; the soul as living plant.
entries.use_in_reading: the tree / perception growing in the natural / the receptive that bears fruit
entries.opposite_sense: Beautiful Tree (Jesus, Tree of Life) vs. Bitter Tree (Hyle, Tree of Death)
entries.definition: Two trees: the Beautiful Tree (Jesus, the perfect Man) and the Bitter Tree (matter). Five trees of darkness vs. five trees of light. Trees produce fruit according to their nature. Trees grow because of the desire of Sin in their root.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Works / goods of life; what the perception-tree produces; the actualized expression of inner state.
entries.use_in_reading: the fruit / the works of life / the actualized goods
entries.opposite_sense: the bitter fruits (works of evil) vs. the sweet fruits (works of love)
entries.definition: The fruits of the Beautiful Tree are Jesus and the divine attributes. The fruits of the bitter tree are the works of evil. The fruits of the body are produced as nourishment for the elect; bread fruit = the soul refined.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Interior truths in potential; what contains the whole in latent form; the soul-truth in receptive grain.
entries.use_in_reading: the seed / interior truths in potential
entries.definition: Seeds are crushed for nourishment; they are the Living Soul in its receptive form within plant nature. The grain of barley = the soul molded in the elements.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Origin / interior cause / the source from which a state grows; what supplies all the upper extensions.
entries.use_in_reading: the root / origin / interior cause
entries.definition: The First Eternal One is the root of all the lights. The root of the trees is in the storehouses; the root of all members hangs from the head. Sin's root is within; the New Man's root is in the Mind of Light.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Particular doctrine or truth that extends from the root; that which carries forward the growth into ultimates.
entries.use_in_reading: the branch / particular doctrine extending from origin
entries.definition: The noetic branches that are upon the body of the perfect Man. Branches of the river of judgment. Branches that are cut and replanted = particular doctrines that can be transmitted.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Elevated spiritual state; place of close approach to influx; the higher ground of doctrine.
entries.use_in_reading: the mountain / an elevated spiritual state
entries.definition: The four great mountains under the feet of the Omophoros. Mountains in the cosmos contain wells, fires, elements. The Mountain of Darkness on the south side. The First Man tarries on a mountain of those who serve.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Dominion: positive sense = the zeal of truth; negative sense = the tyranny of self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: the lion / dominating force (positive: zeal of truth; negative: tyranny of self-love)
entries.opposite_sense: in single term holds both senses
entries.definition: The King of Darkness has a lion-face — self-love's dominion. The lion is the head (foremost) of all wild beasts. The seas have lions = predatory natural affections that grasp ships of light. The Living Spirit is likened to a warrior-man saving from the lions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: High intellectual perception (positive); arrogant high-mindedness (negative); related to wind / perception.
entries.use_in_reading: the eagle / high intellectual perception (or its arrogant counterpart)
entries.opposite_sense: in single term holds both senses
entries.definition: The shoulders of the King of Darkness are eagles — arrogance. The eagle is the form of the King of Wind. Eagles relate to the wind-world (perception).

entries.spiritual_meaning: Natural truth in its receptive state in the lowest natural; the affection of natural truth submerged in the receptive natural.
entries.use_in_reading: the fish / natural truth submerged in receptive natural
entries.definition: The body of the King of Water is fish. Fish symbolize natural understanding submerged in the receptive natural. The five sons of First Man are hidden in the manner of fish in the body of darkness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Sensual-corporeal evil; the body of the King of Darkness; the proprium as serpentine evil; the mingled form of falsity in the depth.
entries.use_in_reading: the dragon / sensual-corporeal evil / the proprium in serpentine form
entries.definition: A dragon is the body of the King of Darkness. The Sarmé (Error) is a dragon mingled with the sea after sphere-cleansing. The body has a sevenfold dragon-head — the corrupt sensual head of the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Thoughts / intellectual things (move through air = thought-medium); particular thoughts that fly through the natural perception.
entries.use_in_reading: the bird / thoughts moving through perception
entries.definition: Birds belong to the air-creatures; thoughts as that which fly. The wind world produces birds. Birds scatter from the King of Darkness's voice = thoughts disturbed by self-love's tyranny.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Natural affections (the will-side of natural); animals correspond to particular qualities of will and natural appetite.
entries.use_in_reading: the cattle / natural affections (each species = quality of will)
entries.definition: Five kinds of creatures in five worlds. Wild beasts in the King of Darkness's body. Cattle multiply through Hyle's nature. The cattle correspond to liver in cosmic-body correspondence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Celestial good (positive); the false-good of self-love when in service of darkness; what was good has become love-of-self.
entries.use_in_reading: gold / celestial good (positive); the corrupt good of self-love (negative)
entries.opposite_sense: in single term holds both senses
entries.definition: Gold is the body of the King of Darkness — what was good has become self-love's substance. In the Light realms, gold = the highest good. The five storehouses include gold.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Spiritual truth (wisdom); the second metal in correspondence with truth in the spiritual degree.
entries.use_in_reading: silver / spiritual truth (wisdom)
entries.definition: Silver is the body of the archons of the world of water. Garments of silver are worn by the First Man. Silver is the body of the King of Water world.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Natural good in mediating state; truth-in-natural in its solid form; the corrupt natural good of fallen love (negative when associated with King of Fire world).
entries.use_in_reading: bronze / natural good in mediating form
entries.definition: Bronze is the body of the King of the world of fire — corrupt natural good of fallen love. The body of the cosmic-man's archons of fire.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Natural truth in ultimates (hard, foundational); the lowest natural truth in its solid form.
entries.use_in_reading: iron / natural truth in ultimates / the foundational hard truth
entries.definition: Iron is the body of the King of the world of wind — corrupt foundational truth of fallen perception. Iron tools of the artisans of the world.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The lowest natural / the dense weight of falsity; the body of the King of Darkness's world.
entries.use_in_reading: lead / the lowest natural / the dense weight of falsity
entries.definition: Lead is associated with the world of darkness. Their fruits are lead. Lead is dense and falls — corresponds to the gravitational pull of self-love.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Confirmed truth in ultimates; immutable doctrine; the rock-like foundation of established states.
entries.use_in_reading: the stone / confirmed truth in ultimate / rock of established state
entries.definition: Three rocks (Pillar of Glory, the new land of light, the great Thought) are placed in the cosmos. They are confirmed states held against falsity. The bitter female bound in stones forever in the tomb.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Mediating state where receptive moisture (truth) takes form in air (perception); the medium by which spiritual influx is brought down or up.
entries.use_in_reading: the cloud / the mediating state of received truth in perception
entries.definition: Three clouds (of fire, of darkness, of water) make different signs. Clouds bear the angels and archons in transit. The cloud manifests in the air of the midst.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth in its illuminating manifestation; the visible sign of the Father in cosmic order; the second luminary that comes from the unburied substance.
entries.use_in_reading: the sun / Divine Truth in its illuminating manifestation
entries.definition: The Sun is the second luminary; he comes from the substance of the unburied (Father); he reveals the mystery of the First Greatness; he gives life and light to the cosmos. Sun and Moon are the two ships of light = two eyes of the cosmos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine Truth in its reflective receiving (the natural illumination); the receiving vessel of light at the firstborn-state; the mystery of waxing and waning reception.
entries.use_in_reading: the moon / Divine Truth in its receptive reflection
entries.definition: The moon's disc fills and empties — the mystery of how the Father's light is received and given through cycles. Moon and Sun together = the two ships of light = the eyes of the cosmos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Particular truths and their aspects; the appointed influences of natural states in their rotations; the bound archons in the wheel.
entries.use_in_reading: the stars / particular truths in their cosmic ordering
entries.definition: The stars are the bound archons; they make signs of births and deaths; they have authority through the wheel; they are the corrupted truths bound up against influence. Five planets = five archons of the worlds of darkness bound in the sphere.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A complete state of light; an order of being from the Father; a discrete heavenly state.
entries.use_in_reading: the day / a complete state of light
entries.definition: Four great days correspond to the Father, the Ambassador, the Pillar, Jesus. Three great days are the eras of the cosmos. Days = ordered states of light. Twelve hours of each great day = twelve aspects.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A state of falsity covering truth; the absence of light; the seven-fold work of falsity in the cosmos.
entries.use_in_reading: the night / a state of falsity / absence of light
entries.definition: Four nights correspond to the four bad states (land of darkness, matter, five fleshly worlds, lower spirit). Night does seven evils in the cosmos. Night is the cosmos as veiled.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The trace cast by a state in ultimates; the appearance that follows true substance; what is cast inward of the body's mystery.
entries.use_in_reading: the shadow / the trace cast by spiritual reality / appearance following substance
entries.definition: Hyle inundates her shadow upon the elements destroying fruits. The night-shadow of the night-of-darkness. The shadow of a man on the earth signifies the soul that goes upward in the resurrection-mystery.

entries.spiritual_meaning: First of the five intellectual faculties of the soul; the inmost rational understanding; the principal of the spiritual mind.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'mind' — never 'intellect' or 'reason' for ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ in faculty contexts
entries.opposite_sense: the corrupt mind of King of Darkness (the smoke-world / Saklas)
entries.definition: First of the five intellectual faculties (νοῦς). Mind of Light is the awakener. Mind dwells in the bone (in bound state). Mind is the head over all faculties and corresponds in cosmic order to Smoke (when corrupted) or to the Father's first member (when divine).

entries.spiritual_meaning: Second of the five intellectual faculties; the rational discursion; the moving thought of the soul; corresponds to ennoia.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'thought' — never 'idea' or 'concept' for ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ in faculty contexts
entries.opposite_sense: the corrupt thought of King of Honor's encampment when fallen
entries.definition: Second of the five intellectual faculties (ἔννοια). Thought is the Third Ambassador in cosmic correspondence. Thought dwells in the sinew. Faith is placed in the thought when the New Man is formed.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Third of the five intellectual faculties; the instruction of truth received and held; the rational doctrine learned and held in mind.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'teaching' — NEVER 'insight' or 'prudence'. Polotsky/Böhlig 'Einsicht' is wrong — the Coptic chose ⲥⲃⲱ over loanwords.
entries.opposite_sense: the corrupt teaching of the bitter tree / the false teachings of Hyle
entries.definition: Third of the five intellectual faculties (Coptic ⲥⲃⲱ controlling, despite Greek φρόνησις mapping). The verb form ⲥⲃⲟ = 'to teach.' ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ = 'teacher.' Teaching is the First Man in cosmic correspondence. Teaching dwells in the vein.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fourth of the five intellectual faculties; the deliberative wisdom; the disposing counsel; corresponds to enthumesis.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'counsel' — never 'thought' or 'idea' for ⲡⲥⲁⲭⲛⲉ in faculty contexts
entries.opposite_sense: the evil counsel (in Five Counterparts of the King of Darkness)
entries.definition: Fourth of the five intellectual faculties (ἐνθύμησις). Counsel of life = the Call and Hearing. Counsel dwells in the flesh. The Great Counsel = the Living Spirit's disposing wisdom in cosmic correspondence. Patience placed in counsel for New Man.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fifth of the five intellectual faculties; the considering reasoning; the inner discrimination; corresponds to logismos.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'reflection' — never 'thought' or 'consideration' for ⲡⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ in faculty contexts
entries.opposite_sense: the law of death (in evil's body of five members)
entries.definition: Fifth of the five intellectual faculties (λογισμός). Reflection dwells in the skin. In the body of evil, reflection is the law of death. Wisdom placed in reflection for New Man.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The receptive faculties of the natural mind; the openings through which the natural perceives; the seven gates of the body.
entries.use_in_reading: the senses / the natural mind's receptive faculties
entries.definition: The five (or seven) senses correspond to the five faculties in cosmic structure. Each sense has its enthumesis and storehouse. The seven sense-organs of the body are the seven gates of the head.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The interior life of the human; the receptive vessel of divine truth in mingled or pure state; the substance to be redeemed.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'soul' for ⲯⲩⲭⲏ
entries.definition: The Living Soul (the dispersed Divine Truth). Each individual soul is a particle of the Light to be refined. Souls undergo metensomatosis, can be redeemed or fall to the bolos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The essential being or substance of a state; the underlying reality.
entries.use_in_reading: 'substance' (default) or 'essence' (philosophical contexts)
entries.opposite_sense: two substances = light and darkness in Manichaean dualism = Divine and proprium in correspondence
entries.definition: Two substances exist from the beginning: light and darkness. The substance of the Light bears up under all the gods. Each entity has its substance from which it cannot depart.

entries.spiritual_meaning: External shape or configuration distinct from likeness; the visible quality of a thing's form (vs. ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ = likeness which is relational).
entries.use_in_reading: 'form' (NOT 'likeness' — keep distinct from ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ)
entries.definition: Five forms in the King of Darkness's body. Form of light vs. form of corruption. ⲙⲟⲣⲫⲏ is external shape; distinguish from ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ (likeness) which is relational.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proceeding of a divine attribute from its source; the issuing-forth of love or wisdom into a distinct station.
entries.use_in_reading: 'emanation' for ⲡⲣⲟⲃⲟⲗⲏ — the standard technical term
entries.definition: Three emanations from the Father: Great Spirit, Beloved of Lights, Third Ambassador. Each emanation is a distinct divine station with its own work. Standard Manichaean technical term retained.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Influx; the proceeding of the Lord into receptive state; the divine missioning of truth.
entries.use_in_reading: 'send forth' / 'the act of influx'
entries.definition: The Father sends forth his messengers as influx into the cosmos. The Calling/Hearing is sent forth. Each emanation is sent forth on its mission.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Accommodation to lower states; the divine condescension into the natural; movement toward ultimates.
entries.use_in_reading: 'descend' / 'accommodation to lower state'
entries.definition: The First Man descends to the Deep. Jesus comes down. The Light descends to mingle with darkness. Descent is the precondition of redemptive raising.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Elevation toward inmost; the soul's return home; regenerative motion upward.
entries.use_in_reading: 'ascend' / 'elevation toward the inmost'
entries.definition: Souls ascend to the Land of Light. The Pillar ascends. Light is conveyed upward. The Lord's image returns to the Greatness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Causative vertical motion; the Lord's specific act of lifting captive light; the upward operation of redemption.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'raise' — preserve the vertical motion. Do NOT translate as 'release,' 'free,' 'save,' or 'redeem.'
entries.definition: ⲧⲟⲩⲱ is the causative verb meaning 'to raise, to cause to stand up.' The upward direction is theologically essential — raising the captive light particles. Mandatory: 'raise' preserves the spatial dimension. This is core Manichaean soteriology in Coptic physics.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Loosing or dissolving the bonds; the horizontal complement to vertical raising; the operation of unbinding falsity.
entries.use_in_reading: 'release' (preserves Coptic distinction from 'raise')
entries.definition: The horizontal/dissolving complement to ⲧⲟⲩⲱ (raise). ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = release/dissolve. Releasers (rephbōl) untie the bonds. The dissolution of the cosmos at the end. Together with raise: the two motions of redemption.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Confirmation in falsity; the fixing of evil in its bondage; the imprisonment of corrupt powers in their states.
entries.use_in_reading: 'bind' / 'fix in bondage'
entries.definition: The archons are bound; sin is bound in the body's members; the final binding of the Enemy at the end. The bond is the means of containment.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Conjunction of truths; the operation of bringing dispersed light together; the centripetal motion of redemption.
entries.use_in_reading: 'gather inward' / 'conjunction (of truths or souls)'
entries.definition: The elements gather into the cosmic body. The light is gathered into the new aeon. Souls are gathered inward. The Last Andrias gathers the residue at the end.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Distinguishing truth from falsity; the discriminative act of regeneration; the work of judgment.
entries.use_in_reading: 'separate forth' / 'distinguishing truth from falsity'
entries.definition: The light is separated from the darkness; the chosen from the unchosen; the male from the female of evil. Separation is essential to refinement.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Removal of falsity from truth; the work of regeneration that filters the natural; the daily cleansing of the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: 'purify' / 'refine' / 'choose-out'
entries.definition: The Living Spirit refines the soul. The fire of the great fire purifies at the end. Daily purification through the food of the elect. The senses purify what comes through them daily.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Manifestation of divine truth; the unveiling that brings hidden state into outward expression.
entries.use_in_reading: 'reveal' / 'make manifest'
entries.definition: The Ambassador reveals his image. The Father reveals his face. The hidden state becomes visible. Five works of the Ambassador are five acts of revealing.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Regeneration; the rousing of the soul from spiritual sleep; the start of regenerative motion.
entries.use_in_reading: 'awaken' / 'rouse from spiritual sleep'
entries.definition: The Mind of Light is the awakener of sleepers. Five sons of the Awakener raise the dead. Awakening is the start of regeneration.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Shaping correspondence in form; the molding of the human (good or corrupt); giving definite form to a counsel.
entries.use_in_reading: 'mold' / 'fashion' / 'shape correspondence in form'
entries.definition: Saklas molds Adam. Hyle molds herself in the elements. The Living Spirit molds Jesus the Youth. Molding is the giving of form according to a counsel. The body is molded in five-fold worlds.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Putting truth into external form; bearing of correspondence in ultimates; the descent that clothes the divine in the natural.
entries.use_in_reading: 'clothe' / 'wear' / 'putting truth into external form'
entries.definition: The First Man wears garments to the war. The Living Spirit wears three garments. Souls wear bodies. The chosen receive the garments of light. The Virgin of Light is the robe.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The summons of Divine Truth that awakens the trapped soul; the apostolic word; the influx that reaches downward to the captive.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the Call' / 'the summons of Divine Truth'
entries.definition: The Call is sent down by the Living Spirit; it summons the First Man. The Call together with the Hearing forms the Great Counsel. Call = downward direction of awakening influx. Yes (Sē) is reckoned to the Call.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The receptive response to Divine Truth; the soul's return-call upward; the acceptance of the Call.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the Hearing' / 'the response to Divine Truth'
entries.definition: The Hearing is what comes upward from below in answer to the Call. Together with the Call, it is the Great Counsel. Hearing = upward direction of response. Amen (Hāmen) is reckoned to the Hearing.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The dispersal of Divine Truth in the natural for redemption; the suffering of the Living Soul in matter; the Lord's tribulation taken on the cross.
entries.use_in_reading: 'crucify' / 'disperse for redemption'
entries.definition: The Living Soul is crucified in every body. Jesus's image is crucified. The cross of light = the suffering of dispersed truth. Crucifixion is the substance-of-redemption.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The carrying upward of refined truth; the lift toward the inmost states; the conveyance of states upward through the discrete degrees.
entries.use_in_reading: 'convey upward' / 'lift through degrees'
entries.definition: The faculties convey upward — reflection conveys the matter to counsel, counsel to teaching, teaching to thought, thought to mind. The way of regenerative ascent through the discrete degrees.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Putting in disordered state; the King of Darkness's flesh disperses; also the centrifugal redemptive scattering of the Five Sons over the cosmos for redemption.
entries.use_in_reading: 'scatter forth' / 'disperse'
entries.definition: The Living Spirit scatters his sons across the worlds. Hyle's begettings are scattered. The chosen scatter on the Cross of Light at sunrise.

entries.spiritual_meaning: That which is in conjunction with the Lord; that which has spiritual life from divine love; what proceeds from the Father.
entries.use_in_reading: 'living' / 'in conjunction with the Lord'
entries.definition: Living Soul, Living Air, Living Fire, Living Spirit, Living Water — all the modes of divine life flowing through cosmos. 'Living' marks substance that has the Father's life.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Spiritually severed from the Lord; in the state of self-love that is spiritual death; without divine influx.
entries.use_in_reading: 'dead' / 'spiritually severed from the Lord'
entries.definition: The body of fallen substance is dead. The two deaths: first death = mingled state during the cosmos; second death = the final separation of unredeemed at the bolos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: That which is conjoined with divine good; the regenerate state; what belongs to the Father's substance.
entries.use_in_reading: 'holy' / 'consecrated to divine good'
entries.definition: The Holy Spirit; the holy ones (the elect); fifty holy days. The 100 holy days of fasting. Holy = belonging to the Father's substance, separated from the corrupt mingling.

entries.spiritual_meaning: That which is in interior state, not yet expressed in form; the deeper reality not visible in ultimate; the inmost state of divine.
entries.use_in_reading: 'hidden' / 'in interior state'
entries.definition: The Father is hidden, untouchable. The hidden ones are the inner heavenly. Hidden vs. manifest = inner vs. outer state of divine. The mystery is the hidden truth that becomes expressed in cosmic correspondence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Primal / inmost / from the source; what stands first in order of emanation; the original state.
entries.use_in_reading: 'first' / 'primal' / 'inmost'
entries.definition: The First Father; the First Man; the first emanation; the first standing-fast. First marks the inmost pole of the mystery.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Final / consummating; what closes the order; the eschatological state.
entries.use_in_reading: 'last' / 'final' / 'consummating'
entries.definition: The Last Andrias / Panaretos at the end. The last extraction. The final times. The last weeping of the firmaments.

entries.spiritual_meaning: That which is full of divine love and wisdom; the radiant state of conjunction with the Lord; visible state of inner union with Divine.
entries.use_in_reading: 'glorious' / 'in divine fullness'
entries.definition: Pillar of Glory, King of Glory, the glorious Ambassador. Glory = the visible state of inner conjunction with Divine. The Father is glorious. The chosen receive glory at the end.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Conjunction and polarity; the marriage of opposites; the two essences (light/darkness); the two ships of light; the two principles.
entries.use_in_reading: 'two' (read as conjunction or polarity, not bare count)
entries.definition: Two trees; two essences; two ships of light (sun and moon); two anabibazons; two natures. Two marks the polar conjunctions and oppositions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fullness of process or degree; complete cycle; the three cosmic eras; the three rocks; the trinitarian structure of divine emanation.
entries.use_in_reading: 'three' (read as fullness of process / complete cycle)
entries.definition: Three emanations; three days/nights; three earths; three garments; three rocks; three plagues; three salvations. Three completes a series and marks fullness of process.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fullness in extension; ordered manifestation in all directions; the cosmic order extended through the four climes.
entries.use_in_reading: 'four' (read as ordered fullness in extension)
entries.definition: Four great days; four winds; four climes; four faces; four extremities; four wars; four salvations. Four is the cosmic order in extension through the four directions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete structure of the natural-rational interface; the five faculties; the five-fold organization of life; the standard Manichaean number for completeness in receptive form.
entries.use_in_reading: 'five' (read as the complete natural-rational structure)
entries.definition: Five faculties; five sons of First Man; five sons of Spirit; five worlds (of light and dark); five members; five trees; five storehouses; five mysteries. Five is the consistent number for completeness in receptive structure.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fullness in ultimates / holiness; sabbath-completion; sevenfold ordering of mansions and works.
entries.use_in_reading: 'seven' (read as fullness in ultimates / holiness)
entries.definition: Seven dwellings; seven works of the Spirit; seven firmaments; seventh dwelling = law of death; seven kings of darkness; sevenfold dragon-head; seven works of the body.

entries.spiritual_meaning: New state after fullness; resurrection-state beyond seven; the next discrete degree.
entries.use_in_reading: 'eight' (read as new state beyond completion)
entries.definition: Eight thrones; eight teachings; eight ways down to corruption (with eight ways of life as parallel). Eight marks transition into new degree.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Completeness in broader order; the ten-fold structure of divine works.
entries.use_in_reading: 'ten' (read as broader completeness)
entries.definition: Ten chariots of Jesus; ten firmaments; ten gates corresponding to senses. Ten is broader-order completeness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Completeness in church / state of all aspects; the zodiacal completeness; the twelve-fold articulation of the divine community.
entries.use_in_reading: 'twelve' (read as completeness in church / all aspects)
entries.definition: Twelve aeons of Greatness; twelve hours; twelve great gods; twelve members of New Man; twelve judges; twelve zodiac signs; twelve cities of Watchers' sons; twelve seals.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Active shining-forth; Divine Truth in its emitting power.
entries.use_in_reading: ALWAYS 'the Radiance' for ⲡⲡⲣⲓⲉ — never 'Splendor.' Same root as ⲡⲣⲏ ('sun' = 'the shining').
entries.definition: From verbal root meaning 'to shine forth.' A divine title from an active-emission verb must preserve the verb quality. 'The Radiance' names active shining-forth; 'Splendor' names static quality. Title of Jesus: Jesus the Radiance.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Capitalize 'Sin' when referring to the cosmic principle/entity; lowercase 'sin' for the general concept.
entries.use_in_reading: 'Sin' (capitalized when personified as cosmic entity; lowercase when general)
entries.definition: ⲛⲁⲃⲉ as cosmic principle is a major personified figure that gushes up against the Ambassador's image and binds the soul's faculties in body-correspondences.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Greek loanword πλάνη as a cosmic principle/entity; capitalize when personified.
entries.use_in_reading: 'Error' (capitalized when personified as cosmic entity)
entries.definition: Error is a cosmic personified entity, the deceiver in the world; she scatters teachings; the Ambassador must cut her down.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The fullness of divine being; the inmost realm of the Father; the immeasurable celestial degree.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the Greatness' / 'the fullness of divine being'
entries.definition: The Greatness is the great land where Divine substance dwells. The Aeons of the Greatness. The Father of Greatness is established in his Greatness alone.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The ordered manifestations of Divine Truth in the cosmos; each presents Divine in a distinct quality of operation.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the Faces of Light' / 'the ordered manifestations of Divine Truth'
entries.definition: First face = First Man (descending); second = Third Ambassador (revealing); third = Jesus the Radiance (sending Wisdom); fourth = Great Counsel (Call/Hearing). The faces are the ways the Light shows itself for cosmic redemption.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The successive periods of struggle and liberation; the spiritual conflicts of the cosmos through which redemption advances.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the cosmic wars' / 'the successive periods of conflict and salvation'
entries.definition: Four wars correspond to the four salvations: First Man's war, Living Spirit's war, Ambassador's war, Jesus's war. Each war is a period of conflict that yields a redemption.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The three phases of the spiritual drama: pre-cosmic, cosmic, and final-extraction.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the three cosmic ages' / 'the three phases of the spiritual drama'
entries.definition: First age: First Man's descent and ascent. Second age: from cosmic establishment by Living Spirit until Ambassador. Third age: from Ambassador's revelation until the final extraction (Panaretos).

entries.spiritual_meaning: The transfer of souls through bodies; the cycling of state through metensomatosis as a form of judgment after death.
entries.use_in_reading: 'metensomatosis' / 'transmigration of state'
entries.definition: The exchange of bodies as judgment for the unrefined soul; one of the eight ways through the cosmos that does not lead to liberation in this turn.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Flowing channels of natural truth; the rivers of judgment from which salt-water and bitter elements proceed; the conduits through which influx travels in the natural.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the river' / 'the flowing channel of truth or judgment'
entries.definition: The great river of judgment; the rivers that surround the cosmos; the moats of the underworld. Three rivers around the cosmos. Each river has its place in cosmic correspondence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Discriminating between good and evil, true and false; the separating function of the Lord's truth applied.
entries.use_in_reading: 'judge' / 'discriminate / separate by truth'
entries.definition: Twelve judges sent forth from the Greatness; the Judge of Truth sits in the air; daily judgment by the King of Honor. Judgment is the discriminative act of regenerative truth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The cosmic girdle of states; the encompassing belt that holds the worlds in their order.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the Zone' / 'the cosmic girdle of states'
entries.definition: The Zone is the encompassing belt of the cosmos; three zones nested. Pillar of Glory placed in a Zone. Watch-stations distributed in the Zone. The Zone has gates.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A teaching unit; a complete spiritual arc from the master.
entries.use_in_reading: 'chapter' for ⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲁⲓⲟⲛ — the section / chapter heading term
entries.definition: Greek loanword κεφάλαιον = the technical term for the teaching units in this corpus.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Three or seven receiving pits where the corruption of the dispersed evil is gathered; the cosmic settling-places of negative residue.
entries.use_in_reading: 'fossa / pit' / 'the receiving pit of corrupt residue'
entries.definition: Three fossae receive the strongholds of deceit. Seven fossae receive the dispersed nakedness of evil. They go down to the Omophoros's foot.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The chosen souls; those refined out from the mingling and gathered for ascent.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the elect' / 'the chosen souls'
entries.definition: The elect (eklektoi) are those who pass through fasting and the right food, building the New Man within. The chosen ones at the end gather around the throne.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Three discrete degrees of human form: pneumatic (spiritual = New Man), psychic (soul's mediating state), somatic (body / Old Man).
