entries.use_in_reading: 'pneumatic' (spiritual), 'psychic' (intermediate), 'somatic' (bodily) — the three discrete degrees in the human
entries.definition: Three icons exist in the elect man: pneumatic (the New Man with the Mind of Light), psychic (residue of New Man bound in flesh = Old Man), somatic (the body itself).

entries.spiritual_meaning: The mirror-disc that exists before the King of Honor's gate; the cosmic mechanism by which all hidden falsity becomes manifest before judgment.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the prochos / mirror' / 'the cosmic mirror of judgment'
entries.definition: Twelve seals exist in the prochos. Whatever the archons wish to do is revealed in the prochos before the great Gate of Honor. It is the mirror of cosmic discriminative truth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The summons that come down through the cosmos as rains and influxes; three summonses (storehouses-roots, plants-from-temples, and powers-rooted-below).
entries.use_in_reading: 'the wells / summonses' / 'the channels of influx between heaven and earth'
entries.definition: Three wells exist in the Zone: from heavens to lands (the root of those above), from heavens to trees, from powers above to flesh-worlds. The wells correspond to the streams by which life flows in the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Conjunction with divine love through the medium of truth; the Lord's special impartation in ultimates.
entries.use_in_reading: 'anoint' / 'impart by divine conjunction'
entries.definition: Jesus the Son receives anointing in the living air. Anointing represents the seal of the Lord's love-and-wisdom upon the human in ultimates.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The miscarried evil offspring of the archons; falsities-from-evil that were ejected from heaven and fell to earth.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the abortions / fallen offspring' / 'miscarried evils'
entries.definition: When the Ambassador revealed his image, the archons' offspring were ejected; they fell to earth as 'abortions' and contributed to the molding of Adam through the Watchers.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The All; the totality of cosmic-divine being; the fullness in which all states are contained.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the All' / 'the fullness'
entries.definition: The Father is Lord of the All. The work spreads through the All. The All includes all states from the Greatness to the bolos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The boundary that conceals the inmost; the screen between heavenly states and the cosmos.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the veil' / 'the boundary screen of inmost'
entries.definition: The veil of light hides those who stand at the side of the climes. The Mother of Life passes through to the cosmos.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Predatory natural affections; corrupt loves of the natural that hunt and devour; particular evil affections.
entries.use_in_reading: 'wild beast' / 'predatory natural affection'
entries.definition: When the sun shines, wild beasts retreat to their dens — corrupt natural loves are subdued by the radiance of truth. Wild beasts have venom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The diffusing presence of divine love; the sweet pervasion of the Father's beauty; the perceived quality of conjunction.
entries.use_in_reading: 'fragrance' / 'the diffusing presence of divine love'
entries.definition: The sweet fragrance of the Father; the second member of the Father is the fragrance. Living ambrosia and sweet fragrance are at the end. The breath of the Father pervades all aeons.

entries.spiritual_meaning: An appointed station of guard or service; the discrete watches in the spiritual day during which different events of the salvation history occur.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the watch' / 'the appointed station of vigil'
entries.definition: Five watches in the Zone correspond to the Five Sons of the Living Spirit. The watch of Pherrokatochos, of King of Honor, of Adamas, of King of Glory, of Omophoros — each oversees specific events.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The hidden truths made visible in correspondential signs; the cosmic events that reveal the inmost mysteries.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the mystery / sign' / 'the hidden truth made visible'
entries.definition: The cosmos is full of mysteries — every event corresponds to and signifies an inner spiritual reality. The sun's rising and setting, the new moon, the seasons — all are signs of mysteries.

natural_variants: five treasuries of the First Man
entries.spiritual_meaning: Five degrees of divine good stored in forms; the divine reserves that the First Man comes to guard; the celestial storehouses corresponding to the five faculties.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the Five Storehouses / the five degrees of divine good in form'
entries.opposite_sense: the storehouses of Hyle (her corrupt forms)
entries.definition: The First Man comes to keep guard over the Five Storehouses. They are the five-fold degrees of received divine good in their formal aspect.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The sign of glorified state in ultimates; the diadem of the king-son; what the third angel of light bears.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the diadem' / 'the sign of glorified state'
entries.definition: The third angel of light bears the diadem with the wreath and the crown for the chosen. The diadem completes the regalia of the saved.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Twelve aspects/states of each great Day; the twelve discrete portions of a complete state of light.
entries.use_in_reading: 'the twelve hours / twelve aspects'
entries.opposite_sense: twelve hours / dignities of darkness in the Nights
entries.definition: Each of the four great days has twelve hours = twelve aspects. The twelve great rich gods, the twelve virgins, the five sons of First Man + five sons of Spirit + Calling and Hearing (=12), the twelve wisdoms.

methodology_note: The lexicon was built corpus-wide rather than from any single teaching, prioritizing terms that recur across multiple teachings and carry stable spiritual load. Coptic governs where vocabulary matters; the mandatory glossary terms (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection, raise, likeness, Radiance) are honored without exception and given dedicated entries with explicit instructions. The five-fold and three-fold structures are read as discrete degrees of reception (faculties, worlds, members) following the project's correspondential method. Cosmological figures are read functionally — the First Man = Divine Truth descending; the Mother of Life = Divine Wisdom in receptive matrix; Hyle/Enthumesis of Death = concupiscence as cosmic principle; Old Man / New Man = proprium / regenerate self. Body parts are referred to the Grand Man / cosmic-body correspondence (head = inmost, foot = ultimate, eye = understanding, heart = will). Metals (gold, silver, bronze, iron, lead) are read as descending degrees of good/truth. Numbers are read as correspondences (5 = natural-rational structure, 7 = fullness in ultimates, 12 = completeness of community/church). Where a term holds positive and negative senses (fire, lion, eagle, gold), both are recorded under the same entry with the opposite sense field. Confidence is graded: established for terms with clear repeated correspondential function, strong for terms with consistent function across several attestations, probable for fragmentary support, uncertain only where genuinely ambiguous.
